title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: shinyphaser game lives inside regular Shiny app. UI need load Phaser.js dependencies calling use_phaser() method. set_shiny_session() method helper set Shiny session inside R6 object private environment reused shinyphaser methods many times.
code: library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session() }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: First add simply image serve background game. define x y place image specific point canvas (pixels): x horizontal position y vertical position. add_image(), point image center, x = 800, y = 300 places terrain around middle area scene.
code: floor <- game$add_image(   name = "floor",   url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",   x = 800,   y = 300 ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Create player sprite sprite sheet. frame parameters describe cut play spritesheet: frame_width frame_height size single frame (32x32 px), frame_count = 5 tells shinyphaser many frames use sheet, frame_rate = 6 sets animation playback speed 6 frames per second.
code: hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(   name = "hedgehog",   url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",   x = 140,   y = 260,   frame_width = 32,   frame_height = 32,   frame_count = 5,   frame_rate = 6 ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   )    hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(     name = "hedgehog",     url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",     x = 140,     y = 260,     frame_width = 32,     frame_height = 32,     frame_count = 5,     frame_rate = 6   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Attach keyboard movement sprite. add_player_controls() binds keyboard input sprite velocity. , directions = c("left", "right", "", "") enables full 4-direction movement arrow/WASD-style input, speed = 220 sets fast hedgehog travels (pixels per second). practice, increase speed arcade-like feel, decrease precise movement navigating around obstacles.
code: hedgehog$add_player_controls(   directions = c("left", "right", "up", "down"),   speed = 220 ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   )    hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(     name = "hedgehog",     url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",     x = 140,     y = 260,     frame_width = 32,     frame_height = 32,     frame_count = 5,     frame_rate = 6   )    hedgehog$add_player_controls(     directions = c("left", "right", "up", "down"),     speed = 220   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

what: 6) Add overlap with other objects (collect apples)
title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Use overlap two objects can share space trigger events. step, apples act like collectibles: hedgehog can move , touch fires callback instead blocking movement. first create apples static group place apples map, register add_overlap() "hedgehog" "apples". Inside callback_fun, hide collected apple (apples$disable(evt)), increment score, refresh -screen text. short: hedgehog meets apple, apple disappears, score goes — every hedgehog knows apples true quest objective.
code: score <- reactiveVal(0) apples <- game$add_static_group("apples", "assets/hedgehog/perks/apple_20.png")  apples$create(260, 140) apples$create(640, 180) apples$create(730, 390)  score_text <- game$add_text(text = "Score: 0", id = "score", x = 20, y = 20)  game$add_overlap(   object_name = "hedgehog",   group_name = "apples",   callback_fun = function(evt) {     apples$disable(evt)        # hide collected apple     score(score() + 1)     score_text$set(paste("Score:", score()))   },   input = input ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   )    hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(     name = "hedgehog",     url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",     x = 140,     y = 260,     frame_width = 32,     frame_height = 32,     frame_count = 5,     frame_rate = 6   )    hedgehog$add_player_controls(     directions = c("left", "right", "up", "down"),     speed = 220   )    moves <- c("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")    for (move in moves) {     hedgehog$add_animation(       suffix = move,       url = paste0("assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_", move, "_32.png"),       frame_width = 32,       frame_height = 32,       frame_rate = 5     )   }    score <- reactiveVal(0)   apples <- game$add_static_group("apples", "assets/hedgehog/perks/apple_20.png")    apples$create(260, 140)   apples$create(640, 180)   apples$create(730, 390)    score_text <- game$add_text(text = "Score: 0", id = "score", x = 20, y = 20)    game$add_overlap(     object_name = "hedgehog",     group_name = "apples",     callback_fun = function(evt) {       apples$disable(evt)        # hide collected apple       score(score() + 1)       score_text$set(paste("Score:", score()))     },     input = input   ) } shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Use collision objects block . Unlike overlap (collect--pass-), collision adds physical blocking. enable terrain collision hedgehog, create rocks static group, attach add_collider() player walk rocks. gives level real navigation constraints: apples pickups, rocks barriers.
code: game$enable_terrain_collision("hedgehog")  rocks <- game$add_static_group(   name = "rocks",   url = "assets/hedgehog/obstacles/rock.png" )  rocks$create(   x = 400,   y = 400 ) rocks$create(   x = 600,   y = 500 ) game$add_collider(   object_name = "hedgehog",   group_name = "rocks" ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$ui() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   )    hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(     name = "hedgehog",     url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",     x = 140,     y = 260,     frame_width = 32,     frame_height = 32,     frame_count = 5,     frame_rate = 6   )    hedgehog$add_player_controls(     directions = c("left", "right", "up", "down"),     speed = 220   )    game$enable_terrain_collision("hedgehog")    moves <- c("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")    for (move in moves) {     hedgehog$add_animation(       suffix = move,       url = paste0("assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_", move, "_32.png"),       frame_width = 32,       frame_height = 32,       frame_rate = 5     )   }    score <- reactiveVal(0)   apples <- game$add_static_group("apples", "assets/hedgehog/perks/apple_20.png")    apples$create(260, 140)   apples$create(640, 180)   apples$create(730, 390)    rocks <- game$add_static_group(     name = "rocks",     url = "assets/hedgehog/obstacles/rock.png"   )    rocks$create(400, 200)   rocks$create(200, 300)    score_text <- game$add_text(text = "Score: 0", id = "score", x = 20, y = 20)    game$add_overlap(     object_name = "hedgehog",     group_name = "apples",     callback_fun = function(evt) {       apples$disable(evt)        # hide collected apple       score(score() + 1)       score_text$set(paste("Score:", score()))     },     input = input   )    game$add_collider(     object_name = "hedgehog",     group_name = "rocks"   ) } shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Create one enemies move . enemy overlaps player, end game. add simple enemy loop: create badger sprite, define hedgehog-badger overlap “game ” event, periodically change enemy direction set_in_motion(). invalidateLater(700, session) timer makes badger pick new direction every 0.7 seconds, creates lightweight patrol/chase feeling without writing full AI system.
code: enemy <- game$add_sprite(   name = "badger",   url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/badger_move_left_50.png",   x = 700,   y = 300,   frame_width = 50,   frame_height = 50,   frame_count = 1,   frame_rate = 1 )  game$add_overlap(   object_name = "hedgehog",   object_two = "badger",   callback_fun = function(evt) {     shinyalert::shinyalert(       title = "Game over", type = "error",       closeOnClickOutside = FALSE, showCancelButton = FALSE,       callbackR = function(value) shiny::stopApp()     )   },   input = input )  shiny::observe({   shiny::invalidateLater(700, session)   dir <- sample(list(c(-1, 0), c(1, 0), c(0, -1), c(0, 1)), 1)[[1]]   enemy$set_in_motion(     dir_x = dir[1],     dir_y = dir[2],     speed = 70,     distance = 150,     lag = 0   ) })

text: Use collision objects block . Unlike overlap (collect--pass-), collision adds physical blocking. enable terrain collision hedgehog, create rocks static group, attach add_collider() player walk rocks. gives level real navigation constraints: apples pickups, rocks barriers.
code: game$enable_terrain_collision("hedgehog")  rocks <- game$add_static_group(   name = "rocks",   url = "assets/hedgehog/obstacles/rock.png" )  rocks$create(   x = 400,   y = 400 ) rocks$create(   x = 600,   y = 500 ) game$add_collider(   object_one = "hedgehog",   group = "rocks" ) library(shiny) library(shinyphaser)  game <- PhaserGame$new(width = 1500, height = 800)  ui <- tagList(   game$use_phaser() )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   game$set_shiny_session()    floor <- game$add_image(     name = "floor",     url = "assets/hedgehog/terrain/grass.png",     x = 800,     y = 300   )    hedgehog <- game$add_sprite(     name = "hedgehog",     url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_32.png",     x = 140,     y = 260,     frame_width = 32,     frame_height = 32,     frame_count = 5,     frame_rate = 6   )    hedgehog$add_player_controls(     directions = c("left", "right", "up", "down"),     speed = 220   )    game$enable_terrain_collision("hedgehog")    moves <- c("move_left", "move_right", "move_up", "move_down")    for (move in moves) {     hedgehog$add_animation(       suffix = move,       url = paste0("assets/hedgehog/sprites/hedgehog_", move, "_32.png"),       frame_width = 32,       frame_height = 32,       frame_rate = 5     )   }    score <- reactiveVal(0)   apples <- game$add_static_group("apples", "assets/hedgehog/perks/apple_20.png")    apples$create(260, 140)   apples$create(640, 180)   apples$create(730, 390)    rocks <- game$add_static_group(     name = "rocks",     url = "assets/hedgehog/obstacles/rock.png"   )    rocks$create(400, 200)   rocks$create(200, 300)    score_text <- game$add_text(text = "Score: 0", id = "score", x = 20, y = 20)    game$add_overlap(     object_one = "hedgehog",     group = "apples",     input = input   )    game$add_collider(     object_one = "hedgehog",     group = "rocks"   ) } shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Build your first shinyphaser game
text: Create one enemies move . enemy overlaps player, end game. add simple enemy loop: create badger sprite, define hedgehog-badger overlap “game ” event, periodically change enemy direction set_in_motion(). invalidateLater(700, session) timer makes badger pick new direction every 0.7 seconds, creates lightweight patrol/chase feeling without writing full AI system.
code: enemy <- game$add_sprite(   name = "badger",   url = "assets/hedgehog/sprites/badger_move_left_50.png",   x = 700,   y = 300,   frame_width = 50,   frame_height = 50,   frame_count = 1,   frame_rate = 1 )  game$add_overlap(   object_one = "hedgehog",   object_two = "badger",   input = input )  shiny::observe({   shiny::invalidateLater(700, session)   dir <- sample(list(c(-1, 0), c(1, 0), c(0, -1), c(0, 1)), 1)[[1]]   enemy$set_in_motion(     dir_x = dir[1],     dir_y = dir[2],     speed = 70,     distance = 150,     lag = 0   ) })

title: shinyphaser (development version)
text: Split event handling explicit browser_action server_action parameters. Browser-side calls must now declared browser_actions(), arbitrary R logic belongs server action. Removed action notify_server controls, overlaps, overlap-end handlers, colliders. Added vignette explaining use browser actions, server actions, together.

title: shinyphaser (development version)
text: Reduced high-frequency overlap traffic keeping immediate actions browser registering server events server_action supplied. Added explicit browser_action declarations immediate browser-side overlap collision reactions. Extended browser actions browser state, cooldowns, restricted conditionals, overlap/existence predicates, alerts, semantic events, immediate key controls. Overlaps edge-triggered default notify Shiny server_action supplied; sustained handlers can use mode = "stay" interval throttling. Moved sprite movement delays blocking R sleeps browser timers. Queued sprite physics actions sprites finish loading setup calls set_gravity() lost asynchronous asset initialization.

title: shinyphaser (development version)
text: Added gravity_x gravity_y parameters PhaserGame$new() configuring Arcade Physics world gravity game created. Added sound support PhaserGame$add_sound() new Sound API loading, playing, pausing, resuming, stopping, configuring audio. Added set_scroll_factor() helpers scene objects HUD-style elements can stay fixed camera follows another target. Added set_depth() helpers sprites, static sprites, images control rendering order, including depth set asset finishes loading. Added camera follow helpers sprites, images, rectangles, static sprites, text scene objects Phaser camera can move scene objects. Added PhaserGame$set_world_bounds() configuring Phaser physics world camera bounds R. Added StaticSprite$destroy() removing static sprites Phaser scene. Added Sprite$stop_motion() immediately cancelling scripted sprite movement, including browser_actions(). Added initial visibility control text objects via PhaserGame$add_text(..., visible = FALSE) Text$new(..., visible = FALSE). Added Text$show() Text$hide() helpers toggling text objects creation.

title: shinyphaser (development version)
text: Added new arcade example game (bear). Added new RPG game example (dungeonheroes). Updated hedgehog examples acknowledging game-dialog reloads Shiny session starts fresh game instead stopping app.
